LanguageData.HE_Inti_Terraces.label: stone terraces
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Terraces.description: Stepped beds of carried soil held up by dry-stone walls. Plants grow on them as on good soil. They can be laid on any diggable ground, so even gravel and stony slopes can be farmed.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FittedStone.label: fitted stone
LanguageData.HE_Inti_FittedStone.description: Many-sided stones cut to fit each other so tightly that no blade slips between them. Earthquakes cannot shake them loose.
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Adobe.label: adobe tiles
LanguageData.HE_Inti_Adobe.description: Sun-dried tiles of clay and straw, warm in colour and cheap to make. Storehouses and village homes use them.
